prompt:
A particle moves in a line with velocity $v(t)=t^{2}-6t+8$ m s⁻¹ for $0\le t\le5$.

**(a)** Find when the particle is at rest. **[2]**

**(b)** Find its acceleration at $t=1$ and state whether it is speeding up or slowing down. **[2]**

**(c)** Find its displacement and the total distance travelled over $0\le t\le5$. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $(t-2)(t-4)=0$: $t=2$ s and $t=4$ s **(A2)**

**(b)** $a=2t-6=-4$ m s⁻² **(A1)**; $v(1)=3>0$ and $a<0$ have opposite signs, so slowing down **(R1)**

**(c)** Displacement $\displaystyle\int_0^5v\,dt=\frac{20}{3}\approx6.67$ m **(A1)**

Distance $\displaystyle\int_0^5|v|\,dt=\frac{20}{3}+\frac43+\frac43=\frac{28}{3}\approx9.33$ m **(M1)(A1)** — the velocity is negative for $2<t<4$.
